# Md. Tariqul Islam — Web Developer

> Web Developer from Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Builds responsive websites, web applications, business platforms, e-commerce solutions, and software projects using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, and Django.

## About

Md. Tariqul Islam is a Web Developer from Bangladesh and a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering student at Gono Bishwabidyalay (2023–2027). He builds fast, SEO-friendly, and scalable web applications with a focus on performance, accessibility, and clean user experiences.

## Core Expertise

- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend**: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, REST APIs, JWT Auth
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, Gemini, LangChain, RAG, Prompt Engineering, OCR
- **Python**: FastAPI, Django, pandas, NumPy, Selenium, BeautifulSoup
- **DevOps**: Vercel, Cloudflare, Git, CI/CD

## Services

- Full-stack web application development (Next.js/React + Node.js/Python)
- AI/ML integration and automation
- E-commerce solutions
- API development and integration
- Performance optimization and SEO

## Notable Projects

- **CoverVerse**: AI-powered assignment cover generator with templates, live preview, and PDF export
- **MeTariqul Tec Shop**: E-commerce web application with shopping cart, checkout, and inventory management
- **AI Study Platform**: Document upload, OCR, flashcards, quizzes, and AI tutor
- **Cloudflare Tunnel Monitor**: Dashboard for monitoring Cloudflare Tunnel health
- **IPTV Stream Checker**: Web-based IPTV playlist viewer with stream availability checks
- **PrintEdge**: Printing shop web platform for online print orders
